data.why: the repo ships the Lee et al. 2019 influenza DMS dataset and matching PDB structure used in the README's own example links

goals: browse a site-level selection metric (e.g. differential selection) across the sequence in the line plot
map a mutation-level metric onto the protein structure by chain and residue
brush or click sites in the line plot to update the logo plot and the highlighted residues on the structure
compare experimental conditions (e.g. different serum/age samples) via the condition dropdown
load a different dataset, structure, or description by pasting new URLs into the Data URL, PDB URL, and markdown URL fields
export the line plot, logo plot, and structure view as SVG/PNG figures

review.summary: The tree describes dms-view's purpose and main analysis loop faithfully: survey a site metric, select sites, read the logos and the structure, and compare sera. That matches the paper's two example questions, and the screens I sampled support the nodes. It needs small fixes before filing: add view sharing and the description panel as tasks, correct the branch semantics, fix f5's error-banner claim, and cite the downloaded files for the exports.
